rationale: Math tests use independent numerical references and behavioral invariants; gradient tests exercise real RQVAE forward/backward with a real batch and finite-difference checks. DDP spawns two actual gloo ranks, feeds distinct batches, and gathers nonzero gradients and post-step parameters. Entrypoint calls trainer.main() and checks emitted checkpoint, SIDs, and metrics. The source implements the frozen-target objective, shared-radius projection, squared Poincare distance/flat limit, and stated residual/STE order; mean reductions match the specified elementwise normalizations. Some disconnected/NaN checks are generic, but not the sole evidence. DDP checks rank agreement rather than an independently calculated averaged-gradient value, a limitation that does not make the suite vacuous.
